operations.key: 註冊課務組（動遊系）
operations.old: Registration and Curriculum Section (AGD)
operations.new: Registration and Curriculum Division (AGD)

operations.key: 找系辦時一起帶入學年課表、成績與未通過項目的畫面，直接問缺課要補哪門、已有證明如何認列。若涉及抵免或學籍，再請註冊課務組協助確認。
operations.old: When visiting the department office, bring your enrollment year curriculum, grades, and screenshots of unpassed items. Ask directly which course to take to make up for missing credits and how existing certificates can be recognized. If credit waivers or student status are involved, ask the Division of Registrar and Curriculum for assistance.
operations.new: When visiting the department office, bring your enrollment year curriculum, grades, and screenshots of unpassed items. Ask directly which course to take to make up for missing credits and how existing certificates can be recognized. If credit transfer or student status are involved, ask the Registration and Curriculum Division for assistance.

operations.key: 送件後回到系統查看是否核准；沒有回覆時，主動找導師追蹤。若會影響考試或需請長假，再向導師與註冊課務組確認後續，別把送出當核准。
operations.old: After submitting, return to the system to verify whether it has been approved; if there is no response, follow up proactively with your advisor. If it affects exams or involves extended leave, consult your advisor and the Division of Registrar and Curriculum for follow-up steps; do not mistake submission for approval.
operations.new: After submitting, return to the system to verify whether it has been approved; if there is no response, follow up proactively with your advisor. If it affects exams or involves extended leave, consult your advisor and the Registration and Curriculum Division for follow-up steps; do not mistake submission for approval.

operations.key: 到教務處確認現在屬於初選、加退選還是棄選，再依該階段公告辦理。過去的加退選日期不能繼續使用；遇到逾期或特殊情況，先問註冊課務組。
operations.old: Check with the Office of Academic Affairs whether the current period is preliminary registration, add/drop, or course withdrawal, and follow that stage's announcement. Past add/drop dates cannot be reused; if past deadlines or facing special circumstances, consult the Division of Registrar and Curriculum first.
operations.new: Check with the Office of Academic Affairs whether the current period is preliminary registration, add/drop, or course withdrawal, and follow that stage's announcement. Past add/drop dates cannot be reused; if past deadlines or facing special circumstances, consult the Registration and Curriculum Division first.

operations.key: 操作後重新開啟系統課表，確認課名、班別與時間真的正確。若和預期不同，記下課程代碼及問題畫面找註冊課務組，不以出席或老師同意代替系統結果。
operations.old: After making changes, reopen your system schedule to verify that course titles, class sections, and times are indeed correct. If anything differs from expected, note the course code, take a screenshot of the issue, and contact the Division of Registrar and Curriculum; attending class or receiving instructor consent cannot substitute for official system records.
operations.new: After making changes, reopen your system schedule to verify that course titles, class sections, and times are indeed correct. If anything differs from expected, note the course code, take a screenshot of the issue, and contact the Registration and Curriculum Division; attending class or receiving instructor consent cannot substitute for official system records.

operations.key: 在可申請的期間填寫抵免系統並列印表格，備妥原校成績證明正本。依公告送開課單位與就讀系所簽核，再交註冊課務組複審，別只完成線上輸入。
operations.old: During the application period, complete the credit transfer system, print the form, and prepare the original transcript from your previous school. Follow the notice to obtain approval from the course-offering unit and your department, then submit it to the Division of Registrar and Curriculum for further review; online entry alone is not completion.
operations.new: During the application period, complete the credit transfer system, print the form, and prepare the original transcript from your previous school. Follow the notice to obtain approval from the course-offering unit and your department, then submit it to the Registration and Curriculum Division for further review; online entry alone is not completion.

operations.key: 辦理前先聯絡系辦與註冊課務組，說明要休學或復學，以及自己的學籍情況。詢問導師或代理人可辦理的時間，再安排到校，避免領表後找不到簽核人員。
operations.old: Before processing, contact the department office and the Division of Registrar and Curriculum to explain whether you intend to suspend or resume studies, along with your enrollment status. Ask when your advisor or their designated deputy is available before scheduling your campus visit, avoiding being unable to find signing staff after picking up the form.

parts.old: intend to suspend or resume studies
parts.new: plan to take a leave of absence or return to study

Ask when your advisor or their designated deputy is available before scheduling your campus visit, avoiding being unable to find signing staff after picking up the form.

operations.key: 文件交註冊課務組
operations.old: Submit documents to Registration and Curriculum
operations.new: Submit documents to Registration and Curriculum Division

operations.key: 將申請表及證明交註冊課務組
operations.old: Submit the form and evidence to Registration and Curriculum
operations.new: Submit the form and evidence to Registration and Curriculum Division

operations.key: 依規定把經初審的申請表與證明資料交到教務處註冊課務組。資料請一次備齊，送件仍須在當期受理期間內完成。
operations.old: Submit the initially reviewed form and evidence to Registration and Curriculum as required. Prepare all documents together and submit them within the current application period.
operations.new: Submit the initially reviewed form and evidence to Registration and Curriculum Division as required. Prepare all documents together and submit them within the current application period.

operations.key: 送件後回校務系統查詢最後核定情形，再與自己的課表及畢業檢核核對。有落差時，帶結果找註冊課務組確認。
operations.old: After submission, check the final decision in the university system and compare it with your timetable and graduation check. Bring any discrepancies to Registration and Curriculum.
operations.new: After submission, check the final decision in the university system and compare it with your timetable and graduation check. Bring any discrepancies to Registration and Curriculum Division.

operations.key: 先約好導師或系所承辦，再到註冊課務組登記領表。依當期公告完成訪談、離校與交回文件；領表日期會影響退費計算。
operations.old: Arrange a time with your adviser or department office, then register and collect the form from Registration and Curriculum. Complete the interviews, clearance and document return as announced; the form-collection date affects refund calculations.
operations.new: Arrange a time with your adviser or department office, then register and collect the form from Registration and Curriculum Division. Complete the interviews, clearance and document return as announced; the form-collection date affects refund calculations.

operations.key: 收到復學通知後，依通知期限回覆復學或繼續休學，確認下一學期的註冊安排。若因服役辦理休復學，另問註冊課務組需要哪些證明。
operations.old: When you receive a return notice, reply by its deadline to return or extend your leave, and confirm next semester’s registration. If military service is involved, ask Registration and Curriculum which evidence is required.
operations.new: When you receive a return notice, reply by its deadline to return or extend your leave, and confirm next semester’s registration. If military service is involved, ask Registration and Curriculum Division which evidence is required.

operations.key: 休學、復學要完成正式程序；兵役資料另找生輔組確認。先聯絡承辦，避免只停課卻沒有辦好學籍。
operations.old: Formal procedures must be completed for suspension and resumption of studies; check military service details separately with the Student Assistance Section. Contact coordinators in advance to avoid merely stopping class attendance without properly managing your student status.

parts.new: a leave of absence and return to study

operations.new: Formal procedures must be completed for a leave of absence and return to study; check military service details separately with the Student Assistance Section. Contact coordinators in advance to avoid merely stopping class attendance without properly managing your student status.

operations.key: 休學先備學生證；委託代辦時確認委託書，領表後按公告期限完成離校及繳件。復學則依本人收到的通知辦理，並確認通訊資料正確，別只停止上課。
operations.old: For suspension, prepare your student ID in advance; confirm power of attorney if delegating, and complete campus clearance and form submission within announced deadlines after collecting forms. For re-enrollment, follow the notice received and verify your contact information; never simply stop attending classes.
operations.new: For a leave of absence, prepare your student ID in advance; confirm power of attorney if delegating, and complete campus clearance and form submission within announced deadlines after collecting forms. For re-enrollment, follow the notice received and verify your contact information; never simply stop attending classes.

operations.key: 學分抵免
operations.old: Credit Waiver and Transfer
operations.new: Credit Transfer

operations.key: 修過類似課程不等於自動抵免。準備原始成績與申請表，依開課單位、系所及教務處順序審核。
operations.old: Having taken similar courses does not mean credits are automatically waived. Prepare original transcripts and the application form for sequential review by the offering department, the degree program, and the Office of Academic Affairs.
operations.new: Having taken similar courses does not mean credits are automatically transferred. Prepare original transcripts and the application form for sequential review by the offering department, the degree program, and the Office of Academic Affairs.

operations.key: 把入學年課表與本學期系統課表並排，先看必修是否漏選，再檢查學分與衝堂。若有抵免、重修或補修，另外列出來，選課前一起問系辦。
operations.old: Place your enrollment year curriculum and this semester's system schedule side by side. Check first for any missed required courses, then verify total credits and timetable conflicts. If you have waived, retaken, or makeup courses, list them separately and consult the department office before course selection.
operations.new: Place your enrollment year curriculum and this semester's system schedule side by side. Check first for any missed required courses, then verify total credits and timetable conflicts. If you have credit transfers, retaken courses, or makeup courses, list them separately and consult the department office before course selection.
